posts.en:
dsh-deepseek-usage is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Real-time DeepSeek API usage: account balance with low-balance alerts (browser notification on threshold crossing), token & request stats (total/today/last-60s windows, per-model and per-session), estimated cost — a composer dock plus a settings-page usage panel.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-30fdb184abac8585d963.html
